headline: Bournemouth hold off Leicester 3-1 despite trailing xG and field tilt
paragraphs: Bournemouth beat Leicester 3-1 at the Vitality Stadium in this simulated match. Evanilson opened the scoring in the 22nd minute (xG 0.351, assisted by Lewis Cook), Cook doubled the lead in the 26th (xG 0.186, assisted by Tyler Adams), and Ryan Christie made it 3-0 on 45 minutes (xG 0.574, assisted by Tyler Adams). Jamie Vardy pulled one back in the 72nd (xG 0.191, assisted by Stephy Mavididi), and that was the final score at 91 minutes.

The underlying numbers favour Leicester. They took 13 shots to Bournemouth's 10, with 7 on target to 4, and finished on 3.47 xG against 2.47. Leicester also held field tilt at 55 to 45 and control at 60 to 57, while possession was close at 49 to 51 and pass accuracy at 79 to 77. Vardy's xG for the match was 2.19, and he was denied in the 89th minute from a 0.738 big chance, with Wilfred Ndidi's 0.499 chance in the 90th also failing to find the net. Bournemouth's efficiency did the damage: three goals from 2.47 xG.

Bournemouth's shape held once Leicester's pressure built. Momentum swung to Leicester in the 19th, 44th, 55th and 87th minutes, with Bournemouth's only recorded swing coming in the 79th. Adam Smith (38th) and Dean Huijsen (71st) were both booked for Bournemouth. Lewis Cook had 6 duels won and an xG of 0.47, while Tyler Adams finished with 2 assists and an xG of 0.82. Chaos stood at 25 at full time, with tempo at 3.9 passes per minute.
